question: What data structure preserves scheduled-window membership without forcing each reconstructed camera action into exactly one event?
terminal_objective: Produce a deterministic, analysis-ready action-to-plan membership ledger that preserves unmatched actions and overlapping scheduled windows.
method: Reconstruct the 2,166 verified complete actions from source-representation rows, contain each action against every timed plan entry, emit one row per action-window relationship and one explicit unmatched row for actions with no relationship, and quantify the error from either dropping unmatched actions or summing overlapping windows as if they partitioned the cohort.
authority: Private local metadata and plan transformation only. No pixels, canonical event ontology, event independence, one-owner assignment, target imputation, model partition, archive defect, publication, scientific-discovery claim, novelty, or priority claim.
claim_ceiling: Stage 10Z may establish that scheduled-window membership is many-to-many and incomplete for the verified complete-action cohort: 626 actions match no timed plan window, 1,482 match one, 54 match two, and four match three. It may provide a deterministic 2,228-row ledger that preserves all 2,166 actions and all 1,602 action-window relationships. It may quantify that naïvely summing plan-window totals would overcount assigned exposure rows by 4.342% and assigned bytes by 5.432%, while dropping unmatched actions would omit 25.316% of cohort bytes. It may establish that the two deterministic relationship ledgers total 10,470,310 bytes—0.000644% of the 1.625-TB cohort footprint. It cannot establish a canonical event ontology, independence, one true owner, target correctness, target imputation, a model partition, archive defect, scientific discovery, novelty, or priority.

next_step_logic.if_schedule_bounded_analysis_is_selected: Join through the membership ledger, retain unmatched actions, and deduplicate action identities when aggregating overlapping windows.
next_step_logic.if_one_event_per_action_is_required: Supply a task-native precedence or episode rule and test it separately; do not derive one from plan containment alone.
next_step_logic.if_model_evaluation_is_selected: Choose the deployment event oracle first, then map it onto this ledger; membership alone does not assign train/test partitions.
next_step_logic.if_public_analysis_is_later_authorized: Use the ledger as constructive proof that the archive can be made analysis-ready without flattening its experimental structure.
next_step_logic.recheck_trigger: A revised mission plan, authoritative event identifiers, a task-native episode oracle, or an archive refresh.
